policy_context.execution_authorization_reference: Current owner mission authorizes fresh exploratory shared-collection versus immutable-shard pairs after implementation changes; one pair per unique operation, only after preflight, and no automatic retry of blocked/failed operations. Preserve correctness/durability and every existing resource/containment gate.
policy_context.resource_basis: owner-approved single exploratory pair; operation-specific 1-GiB cgroup and 3-GiB host reserve
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Current mission accepts exploratory measurement limits of shared /var/tmp Btrfs I/O without per-arm I/O throttling or physical-write attribution; record host pressure, do not claim causality, and do not stop unrelated workloads.

workload.durability: M4 fsync_wal plus native collection flush

postflight_workspace.allocated_semantics: observed sum st_blocks*512, deduplicated hardlinks; Btrfs shared extents may be counted more than once
postflight_workspace.limitations: No atomic snapshot/quota backend. A traversal can miss creates/growth/mmap/replacements between observations; no upper bound or verified lifetime peak. One pass, no retry. Deadline is cooperative, not a bound on one blocked kernel syscall.
postflight_workspace.mutation_observer: bounded per-pass inotify; not independent capacity proof; mmap/writeback not covered

postflight_workspace_capacity.proof_semantics: owner-approved monitored soft budgets only; NOT hard enforcement/capacity proof

source_of_authority: Ten successful B3.1 arm-before receipts and their analysis preserved in the canonical M4 handoff and result artifacts; this is empirical successful-run evidence, not a universal host-safety standard

watchdog_summary.sampling_scope: external watchdog; workspace scans are sampled and may miss short-lived files

workspace_shared_extent_inspection.reason: No extra recursive FIEMAP walk in bounded observer; extent sharing unknown, never capacity proof
